page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf of an early modern book. There is no printed text: only foxing (brownish spots and mottling) across the paper, a folded and torn corner at the upper right, and a faint mark at the lower right edge. No page number, running head, catchword, signature, heading or marginal note is printed. The torn corner and the dark edge at the right are the scan's border and the neighbouring page, not printed matter, and were left out.
